component.name: OpenKeyForge
component.summary: Configure macro pads, key decks and rotary encoders

description.p: A vendor-agnostic configurator for programmable macro pads, key decks and rotary encoders. Map every key, knob and layer in a visual editor, set lighting, test keys live, and flash the keymap to the device without the vendor's software. It starts with the CH57x-based pads (12 keys and 2 knobs, and relatives) sold online.
An optional agent adds what the device hardware can't do: typing any text, opening apps, URLs and files, running shell commands, and multi-step macros.
The device needs a udev rule on the host so your user can reach it; see the project README.
